_comment: riverfarm_longhouse: THE canonical proof for the village's real longhouse interior. Rides near_riverfarm (riverfarm_walkthrough's own fixture) through the SAME portal-arrival beat, then diverges -- walks around the longhouse's own building footprint to longhouse_door, enters, walks the room (headman's-corner ledger prop, observe via interact), sleeps at the relocated riverfarm_guest_cot (sleep-beat parity: same two-event stream as every other bed, plus the SAME flavor toast held verbatim from the open-lawn cot), exits, and asserts the round-trip lands back on the exact cell the player stood on to enter. No fixture of its own -- near_riverfarm already carries riverfarm_attuned, so the portal offers Riverfarm without any new fixture authored.

steps._comment: == BEAT 1: door arrival -- identical portal beat to riverfarm_walkthrough's own BEAT 1 (same fixture, same two-destination menu, Riverfarm second). ==
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: The light warms and the air smells of wheat and river water before you've taken a step. Riverfarm, same as the rumor said.

steps._comment: == BEAT 2: walk AROUND both the anchor-stone waystone (12,5, one cell west of arrival -- a straight left move bumps it immediately) and the longhouse's own blocked footprint (rows 6-7, cols 8-14) to longhouse_door's approach cell. up1 clears row4 (open the whole width, no earthworks/anchor overlap there); left6 along row4 to col7 (the gap between the longhouse and cottage_a's own footprints); down4 through col7 (open rows 5-8); right4 along row8 to (11,8), the door's south-face approach. ==

== BEAT 3: the real door -- bump UP into longhouse_door (11,7), interact for the transition. Chronology mirrors guild_door/stairs_up: map_changed fires synchronously, world.gd rebuilds mood/map/entities, THEN on_enter_accomplishment banks. ==
3 entities (longhouse_exit, riverfarm_guest_cot, riverfarm_headman_ledger) + the PC's own sprite = 4.

== BEAT 4: walk the interior bounds -- up3 to the north wall's own row (5,2), then right3 bumps the headman's ledger prop (8,2) & faces it (the (8,2) cell is the prop's own occupied cell, so the 3rd step blocks 1 short at (7,2)). ==
== BEAT 5: observe the headman's-corner prop -- a plain interact (on_interact_accomplishment + toast, the guild_notice_wall shape), no gate. ==
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: Grain against debts, and the debts keep winning most years. Best not to read it over his shoulder.

steps._comment: == BEAT 6: sleep at the relocated cot -- down2 -> (7,4) (real floor, the sconce at this cell is decor and never blocks), right1 bumps the cot (8,4) & faces it. Sleep-beat parity: sleep_toast fires FIRST (held verbatim from the open-lawn cot), then the SAME two-event stream (phase_changed, then the classless-PC fallback 'You sleep soundly.') as every other bed in this codebase. LAST leg before the round-trip -- sleep() advances the phase clock, nothing above depends on staying at day/night past this point. ==

payload_contains.text: Straw tick, borrowed blanket — Riverfarm always finds room for one more.

steps._comment: == BEAT 7: round-trip exit -- left2 -> (5,4), down1 -> (5,5) (real floor), down1 again bumps longhouse_exit (5,6) & faces it. Interact lands back at (11,8), the exact cell the player stood on to enter. ==
